hero.headline: The perfect match for every little outfit

how.title: How it works
how.step1_desc: Searches partner thrift stores and shops for competitive prices for your baby.
how.step2_desc: Builds the complete layette based on how far along your pregnancy is — nothing missing, nothing wasted.
how.step3_desc: Tracks your child's growth and tells you when it's time to size up.

preview.image_alt: Suggested outfits shown inside an app conversation
preview.item1_text: The assistant predicts your child's growth so you can plan ahead and get the best pieces.
preview.item2_text: The ideal pieces are sourced from partner shops and thrift stores that aren't listed on search engines.
preview.item3_text: Only well-kept items at a good price are shown — no bad surprises.
